_finding: The MCP descriptions tell an agent which tool to take and say where a window is deliberate (24.11, after an outside tool-quality score asked for both). The danger is a description that quietly loses its pointer, drops the reason a window is a window, or names a tool this server does not have, which sends an agent to a dead end.

mutations.name: verify_stock_tokens no longer says to find an address with find_stock_token
mutations.find: to get the official address from a ticker or company name use find_stock_token,
mutations.replace: to get the official address from a ticker or company name ask elsewhere,
mutations.expect: FAIL verify_stock_tokens says to find an address with find_stock_token and go deep with stock_passport

mutations.name: recent_impostors no longer says its window is deliberate
mutations.find: list. Each names what it imitates and the listed address. The window is deliberate:
mutations.replace: list. Each names what it imitates and the listed address. The window is short:
mutations.expect: FAIL recent_impostors says its window is deliberate, not a bulk download, and the full archive is on request

mutations.name: address_on_date drops where the full archive is
mutations.find: (the full archive is available on request, hello@proofofstock.xyz). The days that are anchored
mutations.expect: FAIL address_on_date says its window is deliberate, not a bulk download, and the full archive is on request

mutations.name: verify_anchor stops promising every anchored day
mutations.find: Every answer lists all anchored days in `days`, newest first,
mutations.replace: Every answer lists recent anchored days in `days`, newest first,
mutations.expect: FAIL verify_anchor promises every anchored day in `days`

mutations.name: a description names a tool this server does not have
mutations.find: and for one address in depth (prices, premium, its case) stock_passport. An address of the wrong form
mutations.replace: and for one address in depth (prices, premium, its case) stock_passport or token_passport. An address of the wrong form
mutations.expect: FAIL every tool a description names exists on this server

mutations.name: largest_gaps says its caveat twice again
mutations.find: not a trade signal or advice.',
mutations.replace: not a trade signal. Facts, not advice.',
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and says "not a trade signal" once, not twice

mutations.replace: 'Check that our record of one UTC day has not been changed since.
mutations.expect: FAIL verify_anchor opens with the action, then what omitting day does, and says an unanchored day is an error
